# Maghakian Scripts: 30-second Reels teaser plan

**Concept: "From page to screen."** A single ink line runs through all six shots. It starts on a blank page, turns into a production, multiplies into thousands of episodes, and finally becomes your signature. The red #D90429 appears once per shot as one small element, and in the last shot it lands as the triangle dot of the "i".

## Assumptions
- **Output:** 1080×1920, 24 fps, about 30 s, built from 6 Seedance 2.5 clips of 5 s each, trimmed in the edit.
- **Text and logo:** I'm assuming you have the logo as a vector or PNG file. All on-screen text, the numbers and the logo are added in post (After Effects, CapCut or Premiere), not generated. Video models still garble letters and would distort a handwritten signature, so every prompt asks for a clean frame with no text.
- **Colour:** Prompts ask for a black-and-white image with one red object. In the grade, desaturate everything except the red hue so it matches #D90429 exactly.
- **Audio:** Turn Seedance's built-in audio off. Use a licensed track (pulse at about 100–110 BPM, a hit on the logo) plus sound effects: pen scratch, typewriter, clapper, camera whir.
- **Fonts:** One clean sans serif for supers (for example Inter or Neue Haas), white on black, all caps, wide letter spacing.
- **Reels safe zone:** Keep text and the logo between about 250 px from the top and 400 px from the bottom, and away from the right-hand button column.

## Shot plan

| # | Time | Shot | Red accent | Text added in post | Sound |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0:00–0:04 | **Hook.** Macro of a fountain pen nib touching a blank white page in darkness. Ink blooms. | Faint red glint on the nib | "EVERY SERIES STARTS WITH ONE LINE." | Pen scratch, low drone |
| 2 | 0:04–0:09 | **Writers' room.** Overhead slow push over a graphite table: script pages, index cards, a typewriter with hands typing. | One red index card | "SCREENWRITING" | Typewriter on the beat |
| 3 | 0:09–0:13.5 | **Page becomes set.** Camera pushes into a script page, the paper texture dissolves, and we emerge onto a dark sound stage as a clapperboard snaps. | Red tape stripe on the clapper | "FULL PRODUCTION" | Clapper hit as the first downbeat |
| 4 | 0:13.5–0:18.5 | **On set.** Low dolly past a cinema camera, backlit crew silhouettes, haze and practical lights. | Red recording light on the camera | "48 PROJECTS" (counts up from 0) | Camera whir, rising track |
| 5 | 0:18.5–0:23.5 | **Scale.** Slow pull-back from one monitor to a vast wall of black-and-white screens playing different scenes. | One screen glows red | "2,300+ EPISODES" (counts up fast) | Build, hard stop on the cut |
| 6 | 0:23.5–0:30 | **Signature.** An ink line sweeps across white paper and settles, leaving clean empty space. Hold. | None generated; the red triangle comes from the logo | Signature logo writes on, the red triangle drops onto the "i" with a hit, then "FROM PAGE TO SCREEN" and @handle | Silence, pen stroke, single hit |

**Edit notes**
- Cut on the beats.
- Shots 1, 3 and 6 share the same paper and ink, which ties the piece together.
- Use the last 1–2 s of the logo animation on shot 6 as a still hold (you only need about 3.5 s of generated footage).
- Use the frame at about 0:27 (logo on white) as the Reels cover.

**For consistency**
- Generate shot 1 first and fix its seed.
- Use image-to-video for shots 3 and 6, with a frame from shot 1 as the reference so the paper and ink match.
- Run 3–4 variations of each shot and pick the best.

---

## FINAL

**Global settings (all shots)**
- Model: Seedance 2.5
- Aspect ratio: 9:16
- Resolution: 1080p, or the highest available
- Duration: 5 s per clip
- Frame rate: 24 fps
- Built-in audio: OFF
- Seed: fixed (reuse the seed from shot 1)
- Shots 3 and 6: image-to-video, using a still from shot 1 as the reference image
- Variations: 3–4 per shot
- Negative prompt, if the field exists (otherwise the prompts already say it): `text, letters, words, subtitles, logos, watermark, signature, color cast, saturated colors, cartoon, CGI look, warped hands, extra fingers, flicker`

**Style suffix (already included in each prompt below)**
`Cinematic black-and-white film look, deep blacks, graphite grays, crisp whites, the only color in frame is a single deep red (#D90429), shallow depth of field, anamorphic feel, fine film grain, premium minimal aesthetic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos.`

**Shot 1 — Hook (trim to 0:00–0:04)**
```
Extreme macro close-up of a fountain pen nib slowly touching down on a blank sheet of thick white paper in a dark room, a single hard key light from the side. Black ink blooms into the paper fibers and the nib begins drawing one smooth line. A tiny deep red glint catches on the edge of the metal nib. Very slow push-in, razor-thin focus on the nib tip. Cinematic black-and-white film look, deep blacks, graphite grays, crisp whites, the only color in frame is a single deep red (#D90429), shallow depth of field, anamorphic feel, fine film grain, premium minimal aesthetic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos.
```

**Shot 2 — Writers' room (trim to 0:04–0:09)**
```
Top-down overhead shot slowly pushing in over a dark graphite table covered with stacked screenplay pages, scattered index cards and a vintage typewriter. A writer's hands type quickly, then pin one index card onto the pile; that single index card is deep red, all other cards white. Pencils, coffee cup, soft pool of tungsten light in darkness. Pages are blank or blurred, no readable writing. Cinematic black-and-white film look, deep blacks, graphite grays, crisp whites, the only color in frame is a single deep red (#D90429), shallow depth of field, anamorphic feel, fine film grain, premium minimal aesthetic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos.
```

**Shot 3 — Page becomes set (image-to-video using the shot 1 still; trim to 0:09–0:13.5)**
```
Continuous camera push straight into the white paper texture of a script page until the fibers fill the frame, then the paper dissolves into haze and the camera emerges onto a dark film sound stage. In the foreground a hand snaps a black clapperboard shut toward camera; the clapper's hinge has one deep red tape stripe. Backlit haze, silhouetted lights in the background. Smooth, fast-then-slow forward motion. Cinematic black-and-white film look, deep blacks, graphite grays, crisp whites, the only color in frame is a single deep red (#D90429), shallow depth of field, anamorphic feel, fine film grain, premium minimal aesthetic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos.
```

**Shot 4 — On set (trim to 0:13.5–0:18.5)**
```
Low-angle slow dolly move past a professional cinema camera on a rig in the foreground, its small recording light glowing deep red. In the background, backlit silhouettes of a film crew and an actor on a moody set, atmospheric haze, rim light, practical lamps, light rays through smoke. Confident, steady camera movement. Cinematic black-and-white film look, deep blacks, graphite grays, crisp whites, the only color in frame is a single deep red (#D90429), shallow depth of field, anamorphic feel, fine film grain, premium minimal aesthetic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos.
```

**Shot 5 — Scale (trim to 0:18.5–0:23.5)**
```
Starts tight on a single monitor showing a black-and-white dramatic close-up of an actor, then a smooth continuous pull-back reveals a vast towering wall of hundreds of monitors in a dark room, each playing a different black-and-white film scene: dialogue, city at night, a chase, a wedding. Exactly one screen in the grid glows deep red. Sense of enormous scale and volume of work. Cinematic black-and-white film look, deep blacks, graphite grays, crisp whites, the only color in frame is a single deep red (#D90429), anamorphic feel, fine film grain, premium minimal aesthetic, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos, no UI.
```

**Shot 6 — Signature plate (image-to-video using the shot 1 still; trim to 0:23.5–about 0:27, then hold on a still to 0:30)**
```
Clean bright white sheet of textured paper filling the entire frame, soft even top light. A single fluid black ink brush stroke sweeps elegantly across the lower third of the page from left to right, then the ink settles and the frame becomes still, leaving large calm empty white space in the center. Locked-off camera, almost no motion after the stroke. Minimal, premium, monochrome, the only color would be deep red (#D90429) but none is present in this shot, fine paper grain, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no logos, no signature.
```

**Post-production steps for shot 6**
1. Place the vector signature logo in black, centred, with a write-on animation over 1.2 s.
2. Drop the red #D90429 triangle onto the "i" as the dot, with a 4-frame overshoot and an audio hit.
3. Add "FROM PAGE TO SCREEN" in graphite #3A3A3A, small caps, wide letter spacing, below the logo.
4. Add the @handle at the bottom, inside the safe zone.

**On-screen text (post, white sans, all caps, letter spacing +200)**
- "EVERY SERIES STARTS WITH ONE LINE."
- "SCREENWRITING"
- "FULL PRODUCTION"
- "48 PROJECTS" (counts up from 0)
- "2,300+ EPISODES" (counts up fast)
- Logo + "FROM PAGE TO SCREEN" + @handle

**Grade**
1. Desaturate the full frame.
2. Use a hue qualifier to keep only the red, then match it to #D90429.
3. Crush blacks slightly and add light grain over the whole piece for consistency.

**Export:** 1080×1920, H.264, 24 fps, about 30 s, AAC 320 kbps. Cover frame at 0:27.
